items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Sammy Edwards, the drummer, very nice drummer, he didn't go on to be sensational but he was among one of the best drummers I had

ctx.x: became famous, so it is possible that he's telling the truth.

And another thing, he would watch everything, and in the south--he would say a lot of things, but this wasn't anything malicious, but he had--I just wish I had the picture because it's just so comical to think how this race issue was so simple. I believe it was Tougaloo, Mississippi that we were playing, and Sammy Edwards, the drummer, very nice drummer, he didn't go on to be sensational but he was among one of the best drummers I had and we had--
